controles.affirmation: Tresorerie d'exploitation negative deux exercices de suite (titre et resume : 'deux exercices consecutifs de tresorerie d'exploitation negative')
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : 'Cash provided by operating activities $ 844 $ 1,900' pour les exercices 2025 et 2024, et 'Cash provided by operating activities was $844 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, compared to $1,900 million for the year ended December 31, 2024'. Les chiffres negatifs cites (-1 126 et -1 357 M$) sont des semestres : 'Cash provided by (used for) operating activities $ (1,126) $ (1,357)' pour les six mois clos les 30 juin 2026 et 2025.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer 'deux exercices de suite' par 'deux premiers semestres consecutifs'. Sur exercice complet, la tresorerie d'exploitation reste positive : +844 M$ en 2025 et +1 900 M$ en 2024.

controles.affirmation: Un segment sur quatre est passe en perte ; les trois autres segments (Soybean, Softseed, Grain Merchandising) ont vu leur EBIT progresser fortement, de 75% a plus de 1 300%
controles.verbatim_source: Total Grain Merchandising and Milling Segment EBIT $ 173 $ 187 (7) % $ 97 $ 233 (58) % ; 'Segment EBIT decreased 7%, to $173 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026' et 'Segment EBIT decreased 58%, to $97 million for the six months'.
controles.correction_proposee: Deux segments sur quatre reculent au T2 2026 : Tropical Oils and Specialty Ingredients (-140%, perte de 24 M$) et Grain Merchandising and Milling (-7%, a 173 M$, et -58% sur six mois). Seuls Soybean Processing and Refining (+75%) et Softseed Processing and Refining (+1 337%) progressent.

controles.affirmation: Remuneration du CEO Gregory Heckman de 18,9 M$ en 2025, soit un ratio de 499 fois le salaire median des employes (75 124 $)
controles.verbatim_source: The annual total compensation for Mr. Heckman, our CEO, was $18,945,479 [...] and the median annual total compensation of all of our employees (other than our CEO), was $75,124, adjusted for cost of living. [...] our CEO's annual total compensation is 252 times that of the median [...] the ratio [...] without any cost-of-living adjustment is 499 times the median employee. (DEF 14A 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Le ratio associe a la mediane de 75 124 $ est de 252 fois (18 945 479 / 75 124 = 252). Le 499 fois correspond a la mediane NON ajustee du cout de la vie. Ecrire : '252 fois le salaire median ajuste du cout de la vie (75 124 $), 499 fois sans ajustement'.

controles.verbatim_source: As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively, we had approximately $835 million and $478 million in outstanding prepaid commodity purchase contracts, and advances to farmers

controles.affirmation: Le reglement europeen EUDR entre en vigueur en decembre 2026 et impose de prouver l'absence de deforestation pour l'huile de palme et le soja
controles.verbatim_source: the European Union Deforestation Regulation ("EUDR") will require companies trading in certain commodities, including palm oil and soy, as well as products derived from these commodities, to ensure these commodities and related products do not result from deforestation, forest degradation, or breaches of local laws after December 31, 2020 [...] The EUDR's implementation date was first extended to December 2025 and has now been extended again until December 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: Le fond est exact mais la citation de l'ATT ('the EUDR, which becomes effective in December 2026 requires companies...') est une phrase recomposee qui n'existe pas dans le 10-K : la date de decembre 2026 figure dans une phrase distincte. Reprendre les deux phrases separement.
